basic_info.description: Low 30-Year Fixed Rate Specials - Year End Incentives! Move-In Ready new construction, thoughtfully designed single-level one-bedroom optimizing every square inch. Kitchen is sleek and modern, with high-ceilings to further enhance the spacious, light-filled. Perfectly appointed bathroom with storage. The amenity package rounds out the living experience with a pet washing station, bicycle storage, fitness room, community room, central courtyard with an abundance of seating areas and the Master Plan is complete with parks, public art, pocket parks, walking paths, and much more.  All homes include upgraded flooring, quarts counters with modern cabinetry plus S/S GE appliance package including range, microwave, refrigerator, dishwasher, washer/dryer. Images are of our model home.
